interview.secured: The app never explained "Day secured" to me in anything I saw; the home screen only showed '0 days in a row' and 'Day 1 is today', so I'd guess it means you finished that day's task, but that's a guess.
interview.freeze: I never saw a freeze explained on the screens I visited, so I can't say what it is; I'd only guess it protects a streak if you miss a day.
interview.selfReported: The app didn't explain "Self-reported" in anything I saw, so I'd only guess it means you tell the app you did the task yourself without it being checked.
interview.tomorrow: 6 - The streak tracker and stats are the kind of numbers I like to check, but the terms weren't explained and I have no challenge going yet.

goals.text: You have used GRIIT for about a month. Open your profile and scroll through every one of your posts to the end. Then go to Home and compare the numbers: does the streak and the day number on Home match what your profile says? Say in your thought every number that does not match.
